items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I must say that I have never worked for such a clever guy as Benny Meroff... we all got nervous as hell, including Meroff... we had the best band in town... we worked in the theater through '29 and '30

ctx.x: Yeah-- because I jogged around for quite awhile and there was band at the Drake Hotel. A fellow that I knew very well and a lovely guy and he had been at

that hotel at the Drake Hotel -- he had been playing there for something like - say - 15 years and he had a real society sounding hotel band. And, so, I got a call --- I got a call from either the Benson Office or one of the other offices at that time in Chicago -- it's a big one - and, uh, anyway, I got a call from one of the offices and they wanted to know if I would take a job with Bobby Meeker for one night only and, so, I was delighted at the money they paid because what he was doing is that big, big wedding…
